title: Random Selection
summary: Choosing randomly in Luau: math.random(1, #t) for uniform array picks, weighted tables for biased odds, Random instances for seeded/controlled streams. Inclusive bounds — 1-based indexing applies.

explanation.whatItIs: Turning probability into picks: uniform draws from arrays, weighted lotteries for loot tables, and seeded Randoms for reproducible runs.
explanation.whyItExists: Variety: random spawns, loot, events, map votes.
whenToUse: Weighted: build cumulative weights, roll a number, find the bucket
whenNotToUse: Rolling fresh per player every frame for 'fairness' — define the model once
tips: math.random() with no args gives [0,1); with one arg, 1..n inclusive
Shuffle via Fisher-Yates for no-repeat sequences
Seed sharing lets clients reproduce server rolls (cosmetics)
commonMistakes: math.random(0, #t) — 0 index isn't an array slot
Weights that don't reflect intent (0-weight entries still written into tables)
Re-seeding Random every roll with similar seeds → correlated output

examples.title: Uniform and weighted picks
examples.code:
-- Uniform:
local maps = {"Desert", "Cavern", "Skyline"}
local pick = maps[math.random(#maps)]

-- Weighted loot:
local loot = {
    { item = "Common Sword", weight = 70 },
    { item = "Rare Shield",  weight = 25 },
    { item = "Legendary Helm", weight = 5 },
}

local function weightedPick()
    local total = 0
    for _, entry in loot do total += entry.weight end

    local roll = math.random() * total
    for _, entry in loot do
        roll -= entry.weight
        if roll <= 0 then return entry.item end
    end
    return loot[#loot].item
end

print(weightedPick())

-- Seeded:
local rng = Random.new(12345)
print(rng:NextInteger(1, 6))
